question: Which meats do Vietnamese factory-canteen protein dishes use, by dish-day (pork, chicken, fish, egg, tofu), and how much protein is in each dish?
why_it_matters: Animals spared per canteen meal differ about 34-fold between a pork dish (0.0016) and a chicken dish (0.055); cost per animal spared cannot be narrowed without it. It also fixes the package's unmeasured 20 g protein per dish.
cheapest_way_to_close: Collect four weeks of published or supplied menus from five large caterers and two factory kitchens; log dish species in the DMV-05 trial.
owner_org_to_ask: Large contract caterers (CHN-41); Hai Phong Labour Federation (CHN-39)

question: What share of processed meat volume (gio, cha, sausages, canned) is pork, poultry and beef?
why_it_matters: Sets the species mix of the hybrid route; the ruminant share drives about half of R3's CO2e and the poultry share most of its animals.
cheapest_way_to_close: Processors' annual reports by product line; a question to the meat processors' association (links to DMV-09).
owner_org_to_ask: Vissan; Masan MEATLife; meat processors' association

question: Do added chay days also displace fish and eggs, and by how much?
why_it_matters: The model counts meat only; fish counts per kg are far higher than poultry, so welfare funders' animal totals for R2 and R4 could be much larger.
cheapest_way_to_close: Add a 24-hour recall item on chay days to the DMV-01 survey question.
owner_org_to_ask: National Institute of Nutrition; General Statistics Office

question: Would Nova Vista (or a similar market-shaping funder) count domestic textured soy, blends or a canteen protein ingredient as 'innovative protein', and would it consider Vietnam in a later round?
why_it_matters: Decides whether TPP-01, TPP-03 and TPP-04 procurement or offtake asks are fundable at all; the RFP names plant-based meat, fermentation-derived protein and cultivated meat and excludes whole-food work.
cheapest_way_to_close: One email to the RFP contact with a two-paragraph Vietnam concept.

question: Which funder would pay for a Vietnamese canteen trial now that ACE Movement Grants exclude diet change, ReRoot excludes Vietnam and Lever is not in Vietnam?
why_it_matters: DMV-05 is Part VI's main test of the displacing canteen route; without a payer it stays a recommendation.
cheapest_way_to_close: Three calls: Humane World Viet Nam (implementer), Coefficient Giving (emerging-economy movement building), the Navigation Fund (institutional impact).
owner_org_to_ask: Humane World for Animals; Coefficient Giving; The Navigation Fund

question: What does Humane World's Forward Food menu work cost per meal shifted, and did any Vietnamese institution trained in 2025 commit to menu changes?
why_it_matters: The only implementer metric with a Vietnam presence; would replace our four cost cases with a revealed cost.
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask Humane World for programme cost and commitments by country.

question: When will the school food standards under UNICEF's 2027 to 2031 programme and MOET's unified national menu be drafted, and is protein quality (not animal share) in scope?
why_it_matters: Decides whether DMV-17 has a window and which version (procurement or protein quality) to pursue.
cheapest_way_to_close: One call to UNICEF Viet Nam's nutrition section and the MOET Department of Students.

question: What are current (post-2015) life-cycle emission intensities for Vietnamese pork and poultry per kg carcass?
why_it_matters: Our factors are GLEAM 2005; newer values could shift CO2e by perhaps 20% but would not change any ranking or conclusion.
cheapest_way_to_close: GLEAM 3 dashboard or a Vietnamese cradle-to-carcass LCA if one appears.
